newsitem.title: USA: Circon urges rejection of US Surgical bid.
newsitem.headline: Circon urges rejection of US Surgical bid.

text.p: Circon Corp said Monday it had recommended that shareholders reject U.S. Surgical Corp's revised $14.50 per share tender offer for Circon.
In a statement, Circon said the bid "does not adequately reflect the inherent value of the company's common stock."
Shares of Circon were off 1/8 at 14-1/2 just after midday, while U.S. Surgical was up 1/2 to 37-1/4.

Connecticut-based U.S. Surgical launched an $18-per-share offer for Circon last August, then cut the bid to $17 in December. Two weeks ago it reduced the bid again, to $14.50 a share, complaining of a poor earnings performance by Circon in 1997's first quarter.
Circon, a supplier of minimally invasive urologocial and gynecological surgery products, earned $0.06 per share in the first quarter versus $0.13 a year earlier.
